text: Can you access and edit the docs/design/concept.pen page that is opened in my IDE ?
Look at docs/design/polish.pen thanks to Pen.dev, organize the board with the different screens then create a full UI/UX review of it in a markdown file.
Now create a new markdown file with ideas to add more creativity to this app using external resources like 21st.dev or other libraries to give the app a unique aspect.
Now create a new markdown file with ideas of skins to add. Look at global.css first to understand what is already implemented..
Finally create a new markdown file with your recommendations for future improvements. Feel free to provide all you think in this file.
